title: Math Priority
summary: A 42-day plan for students whose Math section trails Reading and Writing: most study time goes to Math in official-weight order (Algebra and Advanced Math first), with Desmos routines throughout and R&W kept warm.

resources.label: SAT Practice Bank (filter by domain, skill and difficulty)

error_codes.meaning: Content: did not know the rule, formula or skill
Process: knew it but set it up or read it wrongly
Time: rushed or ran out of time
Named slip: a specific, nameable careless error
Guess-right: correct but unsure; review as a miss

schedule.who_for: Your Math section score is clearly below your R&W score (for example by 80 points or more), or your Math errors dominate your Notebook. About 5–8 hours a week (heavier in mock weeks), with roughly three quarters of non-mock time on Math and the rest on R&W maintenance.
rules: Math domains in order of official weight: Algebra and Advanced Math (about 35% each) before Problem-Solving and Data Analysis and Geometry and Trigonometry (about 15% each).
Every Math session ends with at least one question solved two ways: algebra and Desmos.
Two short R&W maintenance sessions a week; never skip them.
Full mock at the start of weeks 1, 3 and 5; timed Math module every week.

phases.label: Algebra to automatic
phases.goal: Linear equations, functions, systems and inequalities; Desmos graphing routines.

phases.label: Advanced Math
phases.goal: Quadratics, exponentials, functions and equivalent expressions; parameters with sliders.

phases.label: Data, geometry and hard modules
phases.goal: Smaller domains, hard-module traps, SPR precision.

weeks.label: Week 1: Baseline and linear algebra

tasks: Full timed mock in the SAT simulator (https://sat.schood.online) at your real test time; one sitting with a 10-minute break
Forensic review of the mock: re-solve each missed, guessed and slow question before reading the explanation; assign cause codes C/P/T/X/G; name the trap; write a rule sentence
Math misses by skill; mark which were C, P, T, X
Read Math: Algebra — linear equations in one and two variables (/math-algebra), 20 min
SAT Practice Bank: 20 medium questions in Algebra → Linear equations (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Log misses and guesses in the Notebook with a cause code and a rule sentence (https://practice.sat.schood.online/notebook)
SAT Practice Bank: 12 medium questions in Standard English Conventions (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 10 min
Read Math: Algebra — linear functions: slope, intercept, interpretation (/math-algebra), 20 min
SAT Practice Bank: 20 medium questions in Algebra → Linear functions (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Read Desmos and Calculator Strategy — graphing both sides and intersections (/desmos-and-calculator-strategy), 25 min
SAT Practice Bank: 12 medium questions in Algebra, solved twice: algebra and Desmos (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Re-solve Notebook entries from the last 2–3 days without notes; close only correct re-solves
Rest day: no SAT work. Optional 20 minutes of reading nonfiction you enjoy

weeks.checkpoint: Pass: Math misses classified; linear-equation accuracy rising in the Bank.

weeks.label: Week 2: Systems and inequalities

tasks: Read Math: Algebra — systems: one, none or infinitely many solutions (/math-algebra), 20 min
SAT Practice Bank: 20 medium questions in Algebra → Systems of linear equations (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
SAT Practice Bank: 12 medium questions in Information and Ideas (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 10 min
Read Math: Algebra — linear inequalities (/math-algebra), 15 min
SAT Practice Bank: 15 medium questions in Algebra → Linear inequalities (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Read Desmos Power Moves (premium) — Move 5: inequalities and test points (/guide-desmos-power-moves), 15 min
Read Desmos Power Moves (premium) — Moves 3–4: sliders and no-solution systems (/guide-desmos-power-moves), 20 min
SAT Practice Bank: 15 hard questions in Algebra → Systems of linear equations (parameters) (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Timed Math module set: 22 mixed Math questions in 35 minutes from the SAT Practice Bank, timer on, Desmos allowed
Re-solve Notebook entries from weeks 1–2 without notes; close only correct re-solves
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 15 min
Checkpoint: Algebra misses in the timed set vs the baseline mock
Rest day: no SAT work. Optional 20 minutes of reading nonfiction you enjoy

weeks.checkpoint: Pass: in the timed Math set, Algebra misses are rare. If not, repeat week 2 days 1 and 4 before moving on.

weeks.label: Week 3: Quadratics and nonlinear systems

tasks: Full official Bluebook practice test (one you have not taken) at your real test time; one sitting with a 10-minute break
Forensic review of the mock: re-solve each missed, guessed and slow question before reading the explanation; assign cause codes C/P/T/X/G; name the trap; write a rule sentence
Compare Math with mock 1 by domain
Read Math: Advanced Math — quadratics: factoring, vertex form, discriminant (/math-advanced-math), 25 min
SAT Practice Bank: 15 medium questions in Advanced Math → Nonlinear equations and systems (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
SAT Practice Bank: 12 medium questions in Expression of Ideas → Transitions (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 10 min
Read Math Hard-Module Traps (premium) — trap families 1, 3 and 4 (/guide-math-hard-module-traps), 25 min
SAT Practice Bank: 15 hard questions in Advanced Math → Nonlinear equations and systems (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Re-solve Notebook entries from the last 2–3 days without notes; close only correct re-solves
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 10 min
Rest day: no SAT work. Optional 20 minutes of reading nonfiction you enjoy

weeks.checkpoint: Pass: mock 2 Math section shows fewer Algebra misses than mock 1.

weeks.label: Week 4: Exponentials, functions and expressions

tasks: Read Math: Advanced Math — exponential growth and decay (/math-advanced-math), 20 min
SAT Practice Bank: 20 medium questions in Advanced Math → Nonlinear functions (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
SAT Practice Bank: 12 medium questions in Craft and Structure → Words in context (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 10 min
Read Math: Advanced Math — equivalent expressions (/math-advanced-math), 20 min
SAT Practice Bank: 15 medium and hard questions in Advanced Math → Equivalent expressions (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Read Desmos Power Moves (premium) — Move 7: overlay (/guide-desmos-power-moves), 10 min
Read Math Hard-Module Traps (premium) — trap families 5–7 (/guide-math-hard-module-traps), 20 min
SAT Practice Bank: 15 hard questions in Advanced Math and percentages (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Timed Math module set: 22 mixed Math questions in 35 minutes from the SAT Practice Bank, timer on, Desmos allowed
Re-solve Notebook entries from weeks 3–4 without notes; close only correct re-solves
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 15 min
Rest day: no SAT work. Optional 20 minutes of reading nonfiction you enjoy

weeks.checkpoint: Pass: Advanced Math misses in the timed set are clearly fewer than in mock 2.

weeks.label: Week 5: Data analysis and geometry

tasks: Full timed mock in the SAT simulator (https://sat.schood.online) at your real test time; one sitting with a 10-minute break
Forensic review of the mock: re-solve each missed, guessed and slow question before reading the explanation; assign cause codes C/P/T/X/G; name the trap; write a rule sentence
Read Math: Problem-Solving and Data Analysis — percentages, data, probability and claims (/math-problem-solving-data-analysis), 25 min
SAT Practice Bank: 15 medium and hard questions in Problem-Solving and Data Analysis (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Read Desmos Power Moves (premium) — Moves 9–11 (/guide-desmos-power-moves), 15 min
SAT Practice Bank: 12 medium questions in Standard English Conventions (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 10 min
Read Math: Geometry and Trigonometry — area, volume, triangles, trigonometry, circles (/math-geometry-trigonometry), 25 min
SAT Practice Bank: 15 medium and hard questions in Geometry and Trigonometry (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Re-solve Notebook entries from the last 2–3 days without notes; close only correct re-solves
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 10 min
Rest day: no SAT work. Optional 20 minutes of reading nonfiction you enjoy

weeks.checkpoint: Pass: every Math domain drilled; mock 3 reviewed.

weeks.label: Week 6: Hard modules and SPR precision

tasks: Read Math Hard-Module Traps (premium) — trap families 8–14 (/guide-math-hard-module-traps), 30 min
SAT Practice Bank: 15 hard questions in mixed Math (interleaved domains) (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
SAT Practice Bank: 12 medium and hard questions in mixed R&W (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Clear due Reviews (https://practice.sat.schood.online/reviews), 10 min
SPR clinic: 15 student-produced response questions; write the exact entry before typing it, following the Bluebook entry rules
SAT Practice Bank: 10 hard questions in Geometry and Trigonometry and Problem-Solving and Data Analysis (https://practice.sat.schood.online/bank); review every miss
Timed Math module set: 22 mixed Math questions in 35 minutes from the SAT Practice Bank, timer on, Desmos allowed
Timed Math module set: 22 mixed Math questions in 35 minutes from the SAT Practice Bank, timer on, Desmos allowed
Use a different question set from day 4
Re-solve Notebook entries from the whole plan without notes; close only correct re-solves
Decide the next plan: Eight-Week Standard (/plans/eight-week-standard) for continued balance, or the Four-Week Sprint (/plans/four-week-sprint) if a test is close
Rest day: no SAT work. Optional 20 minutes of reading nonfiction you enjoy

weeks.checkpoint: Pass: two timed Math modules with few misses and no SPR entry errors.

checkpoints.title: Algebra secure
checkpoints.pass_rule: Algebra misses rare in a timed Math set.

checkpoints.title: Advanced Math secure
checkpoints.pass_rule: Advanced Math misses fall clearly from mock 2.
checkpoints.if_not: Extend weeks 3–4 by one week before data and geometry.

checkpoints.title: Section ready
checkpoints.pass_rule: Two clean timed Math modules; SPR entries correct.
checkpoints.if_not: Repeat week 6 with new question sets.
